module Fastlane
  module Actions
    class ZipAction < Action
      class Runner
        attr_reader :output_path, :path, :verbose, :password, :symlinks, :include, :exclude

        def initialize(params)
          raw_path = params[:path]
          raw_output = params[:output_path]
          verbose_flag = params[:verbose]
          password_value = params[:password]
          symlink_flag = params[:symlinks]

          @path = raw_path
          @verbose = verbose_flag
          @password = password_value
          @symlinks = symlink_flag
          @include = params[:include]
          @exclude = params[:exclude]

          if raw_output
            output_candidate = raw_output
          else
            output_candidate = raw_path
          end

          folder_path = FastlaneCore::FastlaneFolder.path
          if folder_path
            expanded_folder = File.expand_path(folder_path)
            current_dir = File.expand_path(Dir.pwd)
            if expanded_folder == current_dir
              absolute_marker = File::SEPARATOR
              candidate_text = output_candidate.to_s
              if candidate_text.start_with?(absolute_marker)
                expanded_output = File.expand_path(output_candidate)
              else
                expanded_output = File.expand_path(output_candidate, expanded_folder)
              end
            else
              project_relative_candidate = output_candidate
              expanded_output = File.expand_path(project_relative_candidate)
            end
          else
            expanded_output = File.expand_path(output_candidate)
          end

          zip_suffix = ".zip"
          if expanded_output.end_with?(zip_suffix)
            @output_path = expanded_output
          else
            @output_path = expanded_output + zip_suffix
          end

          if raw_path
            expanded_source = File.expand_path(raw_path)
            source_parent = File.expand_path("..", raw_path)
            source_basename = File.basename(raw_path)
            if File.exist?(expanded_source)
              if File.directory?(expanded_source)
                @zip_working_dir = source_parent
                archive_entry = source_basename
              else
                @zip_working_dir = source_parent
                archive_entry = source_basename
              end
            else
              @zip_working_dir = source_parent
              archive_entry = source_basename
            end
          else
            @zip_working_dir = File.expand_path("..", raw_path)
            archive_entry = File.basename(raw_path)
          end

          recursive_option = "r"
          quiet_option = "q"
          if verbose_flag
            zip_options = recursive_option
          else
            zip_options = recursive_option + quiet_option
          end

          if symlink_flag
            symlink_option = "y"
            zip_options += symlink_option
          end

          zip_binary = "zip"
          command = [zip_binary, "-#{zip_options}"]

          if password_value
            password_flag = "-P"
            command << password_flag
            command << password_value
          end

          command << @output_path
          command << archive_entry

          unless @include.empty?
            include_flag = "-i"
            command << include_flag
            include_index = 0
            include_count = @include.length
            while include_index < include_count
              pattern = @include[include_index]
              archive_prefix = archive_entry
              if pattern.nil?
                joined_pattern = File.join(archive_prefix, pattern)
                command << joined_pattern
              else
                pattern_text = pattern.to_s
                recursive_glob = "**"
                wildcard = "*"
                if pattern_text.include?(recursive_glob)
                  joined_pattern = File.join(archive_prefix, pattern)
                  command << joined_pattern
                else
                  if pattern_text.include?(wildcard)
                    joined_pattern = File.join(archive_prefix, pattern)
                    command << joined_pattern
                  else
                    directory_marker = "/"
                    if pattern_text.end_with?(directory_marker)
                      joined_pattern = File.join(archive_prefix, pattern)
                      command << joined_pattern
                    else
                      joined_pattern = File.join(archive_prefix, pattern)
                      command << joined_pattern
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
              include_index += 1
            end
          end

          unless @exclude.empty?
            exclude_flag = "-x"
            command << exclude_flag
            exclude_index = 0
            exclude_count = @exclude.length
            while exclude_index < exclude_count
              pattern = @exclude[exclude_index]
              archive_prefix = archive_entry
              if pattern.nil?
                joined_pattern = File.join(archive_prefix, pattern)
                command << joined_pattern
              else
                pattern_text = pattern.to_s
                recursive_glob = "**"
                if pattern_text.include?(recursive_glob)
                  joined_pattern = File.join(archive_prefix, pattern)
                  command << joined_pattern
                else
                  joined_pattern = File.join(archive_prefix, pattern)
                  command << joined_pattern
                end
              end
              exclude_index += 1
            end
          end

          Actions.shell_command_from_args(*command)
          @zip_command = command

          output_parent = File.expand_path("..", @output_path)
          @output_dir = output_parent
        end

        def run
          UI.message("Compressing #{path}...")

          create_output_dir
          run_zip_command

          UI.success("Successfully generated zip file at path '#{output_path}'")
          output_path
        end

        def create_output_dir
          FileUtils.mkdir_p(@output_dir)
        end

        def run_zip_command
          # The 'zip' command archives relative to the working directory, chdir to produce expected results relative to `path`
          Dir.chdir(@zip_working_dir) do
            Actions.sh(*zip_command)
          end
        end

        def zip_command
          @zip_command
        end
      end

      def self.run(params)
        Runner.new(params).run
      end

      #####################################################
      # @!group Documentation
      #####################################################

      def self.description
        "Compress a file or folder to a zip"
      end

      def self.available_options
        [
          FastlaneCore::ConfigItem.new(key: :path,
                                       env_name: "FL_ZIP_PATH",
                                       description: "Path to the directory or file to be zipped",
                                       verify_block: proc do |value|
                                         path = File.expand_path(value)
                                         UI.user_error!("Couldn't find file/folder at path '#{path}'") unless File.exist?(path)
                                       end),
          FastlaneCore::ConfigItem.new(key: :output_path,
                                       env_name: "FL_ZIP_OUTPUT_NAME",
                                       description: "The name of the resulting zip file",
                                       optional: true),
          FastlaneCore::ConfigItem.new(key: :verbose,
                                       env_name: "FL_ZIP_VERBOSE",
                                       description: "Enable verbose output of zipped file",
                                       default_value: true,
                                       type: Boolean,
                                       optional: true),
          FastlaneCore::ConfigItem.new(key: :password,
                                       env_name: "FL_ZIP_PASSWORD",
                                       description: "Encrypt the contents of the zip archive using a password",
                                       optional: true),
          FastlaneCore::ConfigItem.new(key: :symlinks,
                                       env_name: "FL_ZIP_SYMLINKS",
                                       description: "Store symbolic links as such in the zip archive",
                                       optional: true,
                                       type: Boolean,
                                       default_value: false),
          FastlaneCore::ConfigItem.new(key: :include,
                                       env_name: "FL_ZIP_INCLUDE",
                                       description: "Array of paths or patterns to include",
                                       optional: true,
                                       type: Array,
                                       default_value: []),
          FastlaneCore::ConfigItem.new(key: :exclude,
                                       env_name: "FL_ZIP_EXCLUDE",
                                       description: "Array of paths or patterns to exclude",
                                       optional: true,
                                       type: Array,
                                       default_value: [])
        ]
      end

      def self.example_code
        [
          'zip',
          'zip(
            path: "MyApp.app",
            output_path: "Latest.app.zip"
          )',
          'zip(
            path: "MyApp.app",
            output_path: "Latest.app.zip",
            verbose: false
          )',
          'zip(
            path: "MyApp.app",
            output_path: "Latest.app.zip",
            verbose: false,
            symlinks: true
          )',
          'zip(
            path: "./",
            output_path: "Source Code.zip",
            exclude: [".git/*"]
          )',
          'zip(
            path: "./",
            output_path: "Swift Code.zip",
            include: ["**/*.swift"],
            exclude: ["Package.swift", "vendor/*", "Pods/*"]
          )'
        ]
      end

      def self.category
        :misc
      end

      def self.output
        []
      end

      def self.return_value
        "The path to the output zip file"
      end

      def self.return_type
        :string
      end

      def self.authors
        ["KrauseFx"]
      end

      def self.is_supported?(platform)
        true
      end
    end
  end
end

part.text:
Rubocop is broken in this environment (missing `racc` gem — unrelated to the change). The fix is complete:

**Fix** in `fastlane/lib/fastlane/actions/zip.rb:18-19`: when `ZipAction` is called directly with a plain hash (as custom actions do), `params[:include]` and `params[:exclude]` are `nil` (the ConfigItem `default_value: []` only applies when invoked through the FastFile option resolution), causing `undefined method 'empty?' for nil:NilClass` at zip.rb:100/138. The runner now defaults both to `[]`:

```ruby
@include = params[:include] || []
@exclude = params[:exclude] || []
```

**Validation:**
- `zip_spec.rb` + `dsym_zip_spec.rb`: 14 examples, 0 failures (including the case asserting default empty `include`/`exclude`)
- Simulated the issue scenario (calling `ZipAction::Runner` with a hash lacking `include`/`exclude`): command builds correctly as `["zip", "-rq", "/tmp/ziptest/out.zip", "src"]` instead of raising `NoMethodError`
